Positive/negative labels did NOT leak, but 'this is a test set' did. FP 0/8 may be partly fortified by the agent deliberately avoiding the 'false-positive trap' it inferred. Future protocol hardening: split safe/vuln poles across runs or embed cases in realistic app scaffolding.
